name: Mayflower Inn & Spa, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This 1920s estate feels like a private English countryside manor, complete with manicured gardens and grazing Shakespeare the sheep who serves as the hotel's beloved mascot.
whats_special: The Mayflower sits on 58 pristine acres in the Litchfield Hills, featuring an award-winning spa in a renovated barn and a restaurant helmed by a James Beard-nominated chef. The property maintains its original 1920s charm with Persian rugs, crystal chandeliers, and a library filled with first-edition books.
pro_tip: Book the Shakespeare Suite for the best garden views, and don't miss afternoon tea in the Tap Room – it's consistently ranked among New England's finest.
dont_miss: Take the scenic 10-minute drive to Steep Rock Preserve for hiking trails along the Shepaug River, or visit nearby Washington Depot for antiquing. The hotel's own walking trails offer stunning seasonal foliage and peaceful pond views perfect for sunrise meditation.
pros: Historic luxury property with elegant colonial architecture and refined atmosphere
Full-service spa offering comprehensive wellness treatments and relaxation amenities
Beautiful landscaped grounds with gardens and scenic countryside views
Fine dining restaurant featuring seasonal New England cuisine
cons: Rural Connecticut location requires car for exploring area attractions
